name: Nudist College
source: You are transferred to a new school which is also where your childhood friend is currently studying. Its an all-female school but you somehow end up there due to registry error or is it not a coincidence? The school facilities is great which has high reputation and prestige. However there is a catch. Government often send projects to the school and the recent project requires the students to be nudist. How does it feels like to be a nudist with your classmates and your teachers? Would everything go well or will it end up in a total disaster? Find out more by playing it!​
translation: 你转入了一所新学校，青梅竹马也在那里就读。这是一所女校，你却因为学籍登记出错而莫名其妙地进来了——又或者，这并不是巧合？学校设施完善，声誉卓著，颇有名望。不过，其中还有个问题。政府经常将项目交给这所学校，而最近的项目要求学生实行裸体主义。和同学、老师一起裸体生活，会是什么感觉？一切会顺利进行，还是会演变成一场灾难？来游戏里一探究竟吧！
